clauses.quote: employs and terminates, upon the recommendation of the superintendent, all full-time and part-time employees and consultants;
clauses.notes: Implied subject from preceding list context; represents board authority to hire/fire staff.

clauses.quote: approves the budget and receives from the professional staff financial reports and audits;
clauses.notes: Coordinated predicates; board duty to approve finances and receive reports.

clauses.quote: Provides for the planning, acquisition, expansion, improvement, financing, construction, maintenance, use and disposition of properties and assets within the School System;
clauses.notes: Board duty regarding school property and assets.

clauses.quote: requires the establishment and maintenance of records, accounts, archives, management methods, and procedures essential to the efficient conduct of school business;
clauses.notes: Board duty to mandate record-keeping and procedures.

clauses.quote: Provides for the dissemination of school related information necessary for a well-informed public;
clauses.notes: Board duty to facilitate public information dissemination.
Board discretion/duty to hold hearings when necessary.

clauses.quote: holds in trust for the use of the Birmingham City Schools all property acquired for school programs.
clauses.notes: Fiduciary duty of the Board regarding acquired school property.

clauses.quote: Individuals who wish to comment on a scheduled agenda item may be permitted to do so if they have registered their desire to do so in the office of the superintendent prior to the meeting.
clauses.subject_text: Individuals who wish to comment on a scheduled agenda item
clauses.notes: Public participation right; 'individuals' includes citizens and staff.

clauses.quote: Individuals or delegations desiring to appear before the Board to address an item not scheduled on the agenda may do so after discussion with the superintendent and in accordance with the policy on Non-Scheduled Agenda Items, except for requests by the board for public comment on current issue(s).
clauses.subject_text: Individuals or delegations desiring to appear before the Board to address an item not scheduled on the agenda
clauses.notes: Conditional permission for unscheduled public comment.

clauses.quote: Interested and affected persons who desire to present an item of new business to the board in official meetings shall first be afforded an opportunity to be heard by the superintendent, or his authorized representative.
clauses.subject_text: Interested and affected persons who desire to present an item of new business to the board in official meetings
clauses.notes: Passive construction grants hearing right to concerned persons.

clauses.quote: After a preliminary conference, the superintendent will honor requests for appearance before the board provided that the notice of problems, issues, suggestions and other matters of concern to the delegation shall be presented in writing to the superintendent at least five working days prior to the scheduled Board meeting to allow for duplication of materials and delivery to board members.
clauses.notes: Management duty to approve public requests if procedural notice is met.

clauses.quote: a delegation shall be restricted to a single spokesperson, in any event no more than three (3) speakers on any given topic;
clauses.notes: Restriction on public delegations limits board meeting duration and flow.

clauses.quote: spokespersons must limit their remarks to topics outlined in their written requests for appearance before the board;
clauses.notes: Duty to stay on topic protects board efficiency and time.
